svg.text: Collective-Aware Rank Mapping for Multi-Tenant Training
From Collective Semantics to Task-Level Communication Constraints
We compile collective semantics into transmission tasks,
then add algorithmic dependencies, port-order constraints, and inter-collective release gates.
Add resource order and release timing
Release gate: previous op finish + gap_after
The representation captures collective semantics plus resource-level ordering,
enabling contention-aware rank mapping, ILP validation, and simulator evaluation.
